name: Roding Valley Nature Reserve Wild Fruit
short_description: Apple cherry and plum in rewilded woodland.
description: Roding Valley Nature Reserve was planted as woodland in the 1980s. The mix includes dozens of seedling apple, pear and cherry plum trees producing delicious fruit alongside oak and hawthorn.

name: Claybury Orchard
short_description: Heritage orchard at former hospital grounds.
description: Veteran apple and pear trees on the grounds of the former Claybury Hospital, now a public open space in Redbridge, restored by the Celebration of Orchards project.
